message:
Structural Dynamicist, Serviceability and Crowd Loading Specialist, Retrofit and Maintenance Engineer and the Manager, the device stays invisible from the deck.

The retrofit lives fully below the walking surface with nothing in the parapet void and no change to floor or sightlines at eye height. The recessed cassette sits between the girders behind a perforated soffit screen with a shadow gap, color-matched to the girders, so a person standing on the deck sees no added structure, per the side and bottom layout in the under-deck recessed cassette sketch (E30) building on the midspan layout sketch (E12).

The hidden package fits ordinary under-deck space. The Tuned Mass Damper (TMD), a sprung mass that moves out of phase with the deck, needs moving mass 800 kg per the Den Hartog sizing (E11), which as solid steel is about 0.10 cubic metres, about a half-metre cube like a washing machine, and total hung load 9.81 kN per the hung load estimate (E29), about thirteen adults, carried on the clamped cross-beam above the screen.

Fixed parts are cross-beam, clamps and screen, moving parts are springs plus damper plus mass free only vertically, so appearance and dynamics stay separated. Not ready, because modal mass and stroke must be frozen with Structural Dynamicist before screen depth is fixed.
